programme.title: Carving Printing Blocks: Engraving Master
programme.desc: A master engraver carves letters or pictures into various materials like wood, copper, and stone, continuing a tradition passed down from ancient times. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Enduring the Summer Heat: Mat Weaving
programme.desc: In the sweltering summer, hands weave coolness from strands of sedge. Each mat, boiled, dried, and tightly woven, holds the wisdom of tradition and the breath of community. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Essence of Korean Traditional Dance: Salpuri Dance
programme.desc: Since ancient times, people have held shamanistic rituals to dispel bad luck for the year. The Salpuri dance is an improvised dance performed by shamans during these rituals to ward off negative energy. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Continuing Tradition and Taste: Making Jang
programme.desc: Korean ancestors believed that the taste of Korean food is determined by the quality of Jang (fermented sauces), and without good Jang, there can’t be good food. Experience the deep taste through traditional Jang making. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Traditional Martial Arts, Archery: Crafting Arrows
programme.desc: Hwanghakjeong, established in 1898, is a traditional archery range founded to demonstrate the spirit of Joseon Dynasty, which is not broken by foreign forces, beyond simply being an art of mental and physical training. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Listening to the Mountain Temple: Haenam Daeheungsa
programme.desc: Daeheungsa is located in Duryunsan Provincial Park, a famous mountain in Haenam, with traces of famous monks. Feel the serene scenery and sounds of the temple. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Peaceful Mudflats: The Vast Mudflats at Sunset, Suncheon Bay
programme.desc: Located on the southern coast, Suncheon Bay features stunning reed fields and Salicornia (glasswort) colonies. It is home to diverse tidal flat creatures and rare birds like the black-faced spoonbill. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Mystical Hidden Scenery: Jusanji Pond, Cheongsong EP.1
programme.desc: Completed in 1720, Jusanji Pond is fed by clear waters from Byeolbawi Rock and surrounded by lush forests of Juwangsan Mountain, creating a serene, otherworldly atmosphere. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Autumn Forest of the Royal Tombs: With King Sejo's Regret, Gwangneung
programme.desc: The resting place of King Sejo and Queen Jeonghui, Gwangneung Forest in Namyangju covers an expansive area of 11 square kilometers, boasting ecological stability and species diversity. Enjoy a walk through its scenic forest paths. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, and K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: The Sound of Swamp: Upo Wetlands
programme.desc: How much time has passed in Upo Wetlands? It is a story of lives that have settled and live like masters in the place provided by the river. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Forging My Protector: Crafting the Ornamental Blade
programme.desc: Shaping a blade begins with fire and hammer. In the forging of this small sword lies the essence of strength, rhythm, and tradition. Hear the iron sing as each strike reveals the artisan’s devotion. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.title: Coloring the Crimson: Dyeing in Royal Red
programme.desc: Royal red, extracted from safflower petals, was once reserved for royalty. The repeated soaking and coloring bring out its deep hue. Witness how this noble color is born through layers of tradition. (Provided by Korea Heritage Service, Korea Heritage Agency, K-Heritage Channel)

programme.desc: ヨルムの弟の事件の参考人としてファヨン財団のパク･マングンを召還したドンチの元に、ファヨン財団の弁護士となったチャンギが現れる。カンはチャンギが自分の母親をひき逃げ事故で死なせた犯人だと知り、激しく動揺する。そんな中、イ検事が担当した事件とファヨン財団がつながることが分かり…。

programme.title: 傲慢と偏見、16回 16話
programme.desc: "ムン部長がヨルムの弟の誘拐を指示した容疑で拘束される。ソウル地検から特任検事として派遣されたチェ検事がムン部長の取り調べを指揮するが、ドンチは疑念を拭い切れず…。 一方、ファヨン財団の手先のオ次長はパク･マングンの犯罪証拠を渡さなければ“民生安定チーム”を解体するとドンチを脅す。"

programme.title: 傲慢と偏見、17回 17話
programme.desc: 窮地に立たされた無実のムン部長を救うべく、ドンチとチェ検事は15年前の誘拐事件の黒幕であるイ検察局長の罪を暴く方策を練る。“民生安定チーム”の面々も解体の危機に見舞われながらイ局長の関与を示す証拠の確保に動くのだが、ヨルムはチームを救うためにパク･マングンの犯罪証拠をオ次長に渡してしまい…。

programme.title: 傲慢と偏見、18回 18話
programme.desc: ヨルムにより自白を引き出されたイ検察局長は逮捕され、ムン部長は自由の身となる。ドンチは誘拐事件の実行犯として自首した男、ペク･サンギが偽者であることを見抜くのだが、時を同じくして本物のサンギの死体が発見される。死後15年が経過した死体の後頭部が陥没していたことを知ったドンチは、子供を救うために自分がサンギの頭を後ろから殴ったことを思い出し…。
